result.stdout:
Usage: less [options] [[file]]

Display file contents one screen at a time with scrolling, search, and ANSI colour passthrough.

Options:
  -N          Show line numbers
  -S          Chop (truncate) long lines instead of wrapping
  -F          Quit if content fits on one screen (default: on)
  -R          Raw ANSI passthrough (default: on)
  -X          Don't clear screen on exit (default: on)
  -i          Case-insensitive search (smart case: sensitive if pattern has uppercase)
  -I          Force case-insensitive search
  -h, --help  Show help
  --version   Show version
  --color     Force colored output
  --no-color  Disable colored output
  --json      JSON output to stderr
  --describe  Structured JSON metadata for AI agents

Exit Codes:
  0  Success
  1  Error (file not found, read error)
  2  Usage error
